fixes.explanation: That's the one, baker! The LORD calls it “…a land flowing with milk and honey.” (Leviticus 20:24) Picture that for a second. It's so full of good things that it's overflowing, like dough rising right over the edge of the bowl. And He says He will give it to them as an inheritance.

I know, friend. After a sermon this heavy, a promise can feel too good to be true. But it's right there: “But I have told you that you will inherit their land, since I will give it to you as an inheritance…” (Leviticus 20:24) The LORD says it plainly, and He says it ahead of time. So this one is True, and the land is something He says He will give them.

problems.problem: It uses a reaction phrase. The code shows reactions; the explanation never does.
The passage says the LORD will give Israel the land as an inheritance, but it does not say it is not something they earn.
